verdict.rationale: Square documents unusually broad API coverage of seller operations: payments, refunds, disputes, payouts, invoices, subscriptions, customers, team and labor, catalog and inventory, plus GraphQL, OAuth scopes and an official MCP server spanning orders, bookings, gift cards, locations and more. However, no source claims that the API matches the UI feature for feature, and several dashboard features have no evidenced API equivalent: fraud rules and alerts, consolidated sales reporting, email marketing, and the Square AI assistant. Missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity statement, API coverage of fraud rules, reporting and marketing features, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
